title: Metaphysical Abyss
description:
Metaphysical Abyss is a philosophical game about the journey of a philosopher trying to seek the truth in an abyss full of puzzles and strange people.Welcome to the abyss
You are a philosopher who is tasked with looking for the truth, this truth has been seen heading towards the city of puzzles, a place that usually attracts philosophers and other people with problems in their heads.A parallel story 

Explore the abyss playing not only as a philosopher but also as the truth itself!
Use the truth to solve puzzles and play as a philosopher to unravel the mysteries behind the abyss, the truth and everything else.Key Features:• Solve unconventional puzzles.
• Explore an abyss full of mysteries.
• Follow a parallel story about a philosopher and a truth.
• Try to reason with a vending machine?
description_short: A Van Veen original game. Because everything else is irrelevant.
